model_annotation: This pie chart represents the distribution of stimuli types associated with news articles within Agency B. The chart contains nine slices, representing nine categories of stimuli. “External News Article” constitutes approximately 15% of the total, depicted in a light teal color. “Draft/Other” accounts for roughly 9% and is colored orange. “Article” represents 5% of the total and is shown in purple. “Email” comprises approximately 5% and is colored magenta. “Organizational Report” accounts for 2% and is presented in dark blue. “Interview” represents approximately 2% and is colored grey. The chart includes percentage labels displayed within each slice, and there is no accompanying legend. The segments appear ordered from largest to smallest in terms of size.
